answer: One concrete defense: make each identity post a refundable stake bond, then gate rewards behind a quorum of independent peer attestations. A newcomer begins on the knoll — low trust, payout capped — and must climb a ridge of verified, slashable work before reaching the summit of full earning power. Spinning up a thousand sybils then costs a thousand bonds yet caps each at knoll-level reward, so the swarm never earns back its collateral.
